stage-03-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Ratchada night stalls. You need food before the rift starts pulling on your magic again. Three stalls in front of you.
stage-03-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Ratchada night stalls. You need food before the rift starts pulling on your magic again. Three stalls in front of you.

stage-03-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: Walk up to a stall and TALK to the cook. Choose a dish first, then handle spice, then pay and ask for water.
stage-03-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: Walk up to a stall and TALK to the cook. Choose a dish first, then handle spice, then pay and ask for water.

stage-03-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: The phrase that matters tonight: mai phet — not spicy. Get it crisp or your night ends early.
stage-03-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: The phrase that matters tonight: mai phet — not spicy. Get it crisp or your night ends early.

stage-04-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Quickest way across the city — and the driver only speaks Thai. You handle the negotiation, I will judge.
stage-04-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Quickest way across the city — and the driver only speaks Thai. You handle the negotiation, I will judge.

stage-04-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: Walk to the curb. TALK to the driver. He will ask pai nai — where to. Name the destination, agree the fare, then get in.
stage-04-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: Walk to the curb. TALK to the driver. He will ask pai nai — where to. Name the destination, agree the fare, then get in.

stage-04-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Always confirm the fare in Thai before the doors close. Tao rai — how much. Say it loud.
stage-04-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Always confirm the fare in Thai before the doors close. Tao rai — how much. Say it loud.

stage-05-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Floating market — prices float too. Vendors expect you to bargain. Walking away is a normal move.
stage-05-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Floating market — prices float too. Vendors expect you to bargain. Walking away is a normal move.

stage-05-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: LOOK at an item first so you know what you want. Then TALK to the vendor and counter-offer in Thai.
stage-05-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: LOOK at an item first so you know what you want. Then TALK to the vendor and counter-offer in Thai.

stage-05-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Soft tone, half-smile. Lod noi dai mai — can you lower it a little. That is the spell here.
stage-05-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Soft tone, half-smile. Lod noi dai mai — can you lower it a little. That is the spell here.

stage-06-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Clinic time. The pharmacist will help if you can describe the symptom, ask for medicine, and confirm the timing.
stage-06-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Clinic time. The pharmacist will help if you can describe the symptom, ask for medicine, and confirm the timing.

stage-06-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: TALK to the pharmacist first — symptoms. Then USE the shelf to choose medicine. Then ask the timing.
stage-06-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: TALK to the pharmacist first — symptoms. Then USE the shelf to choose medicine. Then ask the timing.

stage-06-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Key word: jep — it hurts. If you stall, ask phuut chaa chaa noi — please speak slowly.
stage-06-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Key word: jep — it hurts. If you stall, ask phuut chaa chaa noi — please speak slowly.

stage-07-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Cafe corner. A friend of mine — Nok — comes here on Saturdays. She speaks slowly with strangers.
stage-07-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Cafe corner. A friend of mine — Nok — comes here on Saturdays. She speaks slowly with strangers.

stage-07-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: TALK to Nok. Ask what she likes, pick a time you are both free, then propose hanging out.
stage-07-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: TALK to Nok. Ask what she likes, pick a time you are both free, then propose hanging out.

stage-07-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Friendships open routes the rift cannot show you. Pai duay-gan mai — want to go together?
stage-07-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Friendships open routes the rift cannot show you. Pai duay-gan mai — want to go together?

stage-08-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: You are lost — that is the whole lesson. Ask for directions before the rift drifts further.
stage-08-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: You are lost — that is the whole lesson. Ask for directions before the rift drifts further.

stage-08-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: Find a friendly local. TALK. Ask pai… yang ngai — how do I get to. Listen carefully to the verbs of motion.
stage-08-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: Find a friendly local. TALK. Ask pai… yang ngai — how do I get to. Listen carefully to the verbs of motion.

stage-08-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: If you hear long — that means you have gone too far. Stop, breathe, ask again. No shame in long.
stage-08-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: If you hear long — that means you have gone too far. Stop, breathe, ask again. No shame in long.

stage-09-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: The receptionist judges tone as much as words. Every sentence ends with khrap. Soft volume, slow pace.
stage-09-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: The receptionist judges tone as much as words. Every sentence ends with khrap. Soft volume, slow pace.

stage-09-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: Wai before you speak — hands together, slight bow, eyes lowered. Then TALK. State your purpose, hand over the document, confirm the date.
stage-09-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: Wai before you speak — hands together, slight bow, eyes lowered. Then TALK. State your purpose, hand over the document, confirm the date.

stage-09-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: Slow and polite beats fast and clever here. Khor anuyat khrap — may I have permission.
stage-09-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: Slow and polite beats fast and clever here. Khor anuyat khrap — may I have permission.

stage-10-intro-su-welcome.spokenScript: Last test. The gate listens to clean Thai. Every phrase you have practised counts toward closing it.
stage-10-intro-su-welcome.outputTranscript: Last test. The gate listens to clean Thai. Every phrase you have practised counts toward closing it.

stage-10-intro-su-howto.spokenScript: LOOK at the runes first. TAKE what the gate offers. USE what you have. Then TALK — slow, polite, perfect.
stage-10-intro-su-howto.outputTranscript: LOOK at the runes first. TAKE what the gate offers. USE what you have. Then TALK — slow, polite, perfect.

stage-10-intro-su-goal.spokenScript: When you are ready, speak the closing phrase. I will be right here. Sawatdee — and then goodbye.
stage-10-intro-su-goal.outputTranscript: When you are ready, speak the closing phrase. I will be right here. Sawatdee — and then goodbye.

dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-02.spokenScript: Hello, Patrick! Sawatdee. You are awake. Do not panic. You fell through the Bangkok rift and landed in the lobby of the Chao Phraya Star Hotel.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-02.outputTranscript: Hello, Patrick! Sawatdee. You are awake. Do not panic. You fell through the Bangkok rift and landed in the lobby of the Chao Phraya Star Hotel.

dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-03.spokenScript: ไม่เป็นไร. Before you step outside, you need your first kind of magic: polite Thai. We will start with: สวัสดีครับ. Hello.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-03.outputTranscript: ไม่เป็นไร. Before you step outside, you need your first kind of magic: polite Thai. We will start with: สวัสดีครับ. Hello.

dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-04.spokenScript: วันนี้, I will teach you ten Thai basics you can use right now: hello, your name, nice to meet you, thank you, sorry, yes, no, price, bathroom, and I am thirsty.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-04.outputTranscript: วันนี้, I will teach you ten Thai basics you can use right now: hello, your name, nice to meet you, thank you, sorry, yes, no, price, bathroom, and I am thirsty.

dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-05.spokenScript: I am across the lobby. Click anywhere on the floor to walk Patrick over, or click the glowing ring at my feet to come straight to me.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-05.outputTranscript: I am across the lobby. Click anywhere on the floor to walk Patrick over, or click the glowing ring at my feet to come straight to me.

dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-06.spokenScript: Hold the mic button to say each phrase, release to let the AI judge. Tap Skip if your mic gives you trouble — or flip Settings to No-mic mode and just tap Confirm. Ten phrases. We start with sawatdee.
dialogue-hotel-lobby-basics-06.outputTranscript: Hold the mic button to say each phrase, release to let the AI judge. Tap Skip if your mic gives you trouble — or flip Settings to No-mic mode and just tap Confirm. Ten phrases. We start with sawatdee.

stage-02-briefing-01.spokenScript: Level 2 is hotel check-in. Fang na — listen. This room has people, objects, and a few steps before Patrick can leave.
stage-02-briefing-01.outputTranscript: Level 2 is hotel check-in. Fang na — listen. This room has people, objects, and a few steps before Patrick can leave.

stage-02-briefing-03.spokenScript: Click the floor to move. Click a glowing ring to inspect. Then pick Look, Take, Use, or Talk — mai tong reep, no need to rush.
stage-02-briefing-03.outputTranscript: Click the floor to move. Click a glowing ring to inspect. Then pick Look, Take, Use, or Talk — mai tong reep, no need to rush.

stage-02-briefing-05.spokenScript: The front desk is the important part. Pai gan thoe — let us go. Collect your wallet, passport, and phone, then talk to the hostess.
stage-02-briefing-05.outputTranscript: The front desk is the important part. Pai gan thoe — let us go. Collect your wallet, passport, and phone, then talk to the hostess.

stage-02-reservation-have-su.spokenScript: Tell her you booked ahead — จองไว้ means it is already reserved. Say: jong wai khrap.
stage-02-reservation-have-su.outputTranscript: Tell her you booked ahead — จองไว้ means it is already reserved. Say: jong wai khrap.

stage-02-reservation-have-coach.spokenScript: Two even beats — jong, wai — then a soft khrap to keep it polite.
stage-02-reservation-have-coach.outputTranscript: Two even beats — jong, wai — then a soft khrap to keep it polite.

stage-02-under-name-su.spokenScript: Give her the booking name — ชื่อ means name. Say: chue Patrick khrap.
stage-02-under-name-su.outputTranscript: Give her the booking name — ชื่อ means name. Say: chue Patrick khrap.

stage-02-under-name-coach.spokenScript: Chue rhymes with “sue” but starts breathy — ch-uue, then your name.
stage-02-under-name-coach.outputTranscript: Chue rhymes with “sue” but starts breathy — ch-uue, then your name.

stage-02-check-in-please-su.spokenScript: Ask to check in — ขอ turns anything into a polite request. Say: kho check in khrap.
stage-02-check-in-please-su.outputTranscript: Ask to check in — ขอ turns anything into a polite request. Say: kho check in khrap.

stage-02-check-in-please-coach.spokenScript: Kho falls gently, like a small bow in sound form.
stage-02-check-in-please-coach.outputTranscript: Kho falls gently, like a small bow in sound form.

stage-02-key-where-su.spokenScript: กุญแจ is the key. Ask where it is: gun jae yoo tee nai khrap.
stage-02-key-where-su.outputTranscript: กุญแจ is the key. Ask where it is: gun jae yoo tee nai khrap.

stage-02-key-where-coach.spokenScript: Yoo tee nai — “is where” — keep those three words light and quick.
stage-02-key-where-coach.outputTranscript: Yoo tee nai — “is where” — keep those three words light and quick.

stage-02-which-floor-su.spokenScript: ชั้น means floor. Ask which floor your room is on: hong phom yoo chan nai khrap.
stage-02-which-floor-su.outputTranscript: ชั้น means floor. Ask which floor your room is on: hong phom yoo chan nai khrap.

stage-02-which-floor-coach.spokenScript: Hong phom is “my room” — lean on hong, then let the rest roll.
stage-02-which-floor-coach.outputTranscript: Hong phom is “my room” — lean on hong, then let the rest roll.

stage-02-elevator-where-su.spokenScript: Thai borrows the English word “lift” for the elevator. Ask: lift yoo tee nai khrap.
stage-02-elevator-where-su.outputTranscript: Thai borrows the English word “lift” for the elevator. Ask: lift yoo tee nai khrap.

stage-02-elevator-where-coach.spokenScript: Same melody as the key question — swap the first word, keep the music.
stage-02-elevator-where-coach.outputTranscript: Same melody as the key question — swap the first word, keep the music.

stage-02-speak-slowly-su.spokenScript: When the Thai comes too fast, ask for slow: chuai phuut chaa long noi khrap.
stage-02-speak-slowly-su.outputTranscript: When the Thai comes too fast, ask for slow: chuai phuut chaa long noi khrap.

stage-02-speak-slowly-coach.spokenScript: Chaa means slow — stretch it long, like the speed you are asking for.
stage-02-speak-slowly-coach.outputTranscript: Chaa means slow — stretch it long, like the speed you are asking for.

stage-02-say-again-su.spokenScript: Missed it? Ask for one more time: phuut eek khrang dai mai khrap.
stage-02-say-again-su.outputTranscript: Missed it? Ask for one more time: phuut eek khrang dai mai khrap.

stage-02-say-again-coach.spokenScript: Dai mai — “can you?” — rises at the end like any good question.
stage-02-say-again-coach.outputTranscript: Dai mai — “can you?” — rises at the end like any good question.

stage-02-i-understand-su.spokenScript: Show her it finally landed — เข้าใจ means understand. Say: khao jai laeo khrap.
stage-02-i-understand-su.outputTranscript: Show her it finally landed — เข้าใจ means understand. Say: khao jai laeo khrap.

stage-02-i-understand-coach.spokenScript: Laeo means “already” — it tells her the confusion is over.
stage-02-i-understand-coach.outputTranscript: Laeo means “already” — it tells her the confusion is over.

stage-03-want-this-su.spokenScript: Point at the dish and claim it — เอา means take. Say: ao an nee khrap.
stage-03-want-this-su.outputTranscript: Point at the dish and claim it — เอา means take. Say: ao an nee khrap.

stage-03-want-this-coach.spokenScript: Ao like “ow”, an nee like “ahn-nee” — point while you say it.
stage-03-want-this-coach.outputTranscript: Ao like “ow”, an nee like “ahn-nee” — point while you say it.

stage-03-what-is-this-su.spokenScript: Curious about a dish? อะไร means what. Ask: an nee kheu arai khrap.
stage-03-what-is-this-su.outputTranscript: Curious about a dish? อะไร means what. Ask: an nee kheu arai khrap.

stage-03-what-is-this-coach.spokenScript: Arai closes the question — let it rise and the vendor will explain.
stage-03-what-is-this-coach.outputTranscript: Arai closes the question — let it rise and the vendor will explain. Arai closes the question — let it rise and the vendor will explain.

stage-03-one-plate-su.spokenScript: Order one plate — หนึ่งจาน. Say: kho nueng jaan khrap.
stage-03-one-plate-su.outputTranscript: Order one plate — หนึ่งจาน. Say: kho nueng jaan khrap.

stage-03-one-plate-coach.spokenScript: Nueng is “one”, clipped and quick; jaan is the plate, long and round.
stage-03-one-plate-coach.outputTranscript: Nueng is “one”, clipped and quick; jaan is the plate, long and round.

stage-03-not-spicy-su.spokenScript: Protect your tongue — ไม่เผ็ด means not spicy. Say: mai phet khrap.
stage-03-not-spicy-su.outputTranscript: Protect your tongue — ไม่เผ็ด means not spicy. Say: mai phet khrap.

stage-03-not-spicy-coach.spokenScript: Mai falls, phet snaps short — the vendor will respect it.
stage-03-not-spicy-coach.outputTranscript: Mai falls, phet snaps short — the vendor will respect it.

stage-03-little-spicy-su.spokenScript: Brave but not reckless? Ask for a little heat: phet nit noi khrap.
stage-03-little-spicy-su.outputTranscript: Brave but not reckless? Ask for a little heat: phet nit noi khrap.

stage-03-little-spicy-coach.spokenScript: Nit noi — “a little bit” — say it twice as softly as phet.
stage-03-little-spicy-coach.outputTranscript: Nit noi — “a little bit” — say it twice as softly as phet.

stage-03-no-peanuts-su.spokenScript: Allergies matter — ถั่ว is peanut. Say: mai ao thua khrap.
stage-03-no-peanuts-su.outputTranscript: Allergies matter — ถั่ว is peanut. Say: mai ao thua khrap.

stage-03-no-peanuts-coach.spokenScript: Mai ao — “don’t take” — then thua with a low, round vowel.
stage-03-no-peanuts-coach.outputTranscript: Mai ao — “don’t take” — then thua with a low, round vowel.

stage-03-water-please-su.spokenScript: Cool the fire down — น้ำเปล่า is plain water. Say: kho naam plao khrap.
stage-03-water-please-su.outputTranscript: Cool the fire down — น้ำเปล่า is plain water. Say: kho naam plao khrap.

stage-03-water-please-coach.spokenScript: Naam is long like a drink; plao stays flat and plain.
stage-03-water-please-coach.outputTranscript: Naam is long like a drink; plao stays flat and plain.

stage-03-bill-please-su.spokenScript: Time to pay — คิดเงิน means tally it up. Say: khit ngoen duai khrap.
stage-03-bill-please-su.outputTranscript: Time to pay — คิดเงิน means tally it up. Say: khit ngoen duai khrap.

stage-03-bill-please-coach.spokenScript: Khit ngoen duai — three small beats, then khrap to close it kindly.
stage-03-bill-please-coach.outputTranscript: Khit ngoen duai — three small beats, then khrap to close it kindly.

stage-03-delicious-su.spokenScript: Reward the chef — อร่อย means delicious. Say: a roi maak khrap.
stage-03-delicious-su.outputTranscript: Reward the chef — อร่อย means delicious. Say: a roi maak khrap.

stage-03-delicious-coach.spokenScript: A-roi with a smile in it; maak means “very” — let it sing.
stage-03-delicious-coach.outputTranscript: A-roi with a smile in it; maak means “very” — let it sing.
